package contract_types

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func normalized(t *testing.T, data []byte) any {
	t.Helper()
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var value any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&value); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	return value
}

func roundTrip[T any](t *testing.T, text string) T {
	t.Helper()
	var value T
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &value); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(normalized(t, []byte(text)), normalized(t, data)) { t.Fatalf("wire value changed: %s", data) }
	return value
}

func TestRecordPresenceAndExactNumbers(t *testing.T) {
	absent := roundTrip[Record](t, `{"requiredNullable":null,"requiredValue":true}`)
	if absent.OptionalNullable.Present || absent.DefaultValue.Present { t.Fatal("absent/default fields materialized") }
	present := roundTrip[Record](t, `{"requiredNullable":null,"requiredValue":true,"optionalNullable":null}`)
	if !present.OptionalNullable.Present || !present.OptionalNullable.Value.Null { t.Fatal("present null collapsed") }
	for _, text := range []string{`{"requiredValue":true}`, `{"requiredNullable":null}`, `null`} {
		var value Record
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &value) == nil { t.Fatal("missing required member accepted", text) }
	}
	roundTrip[Record](t, `{"requiredNullable":null,"requiredValue":null,"defaultValue":"","large":12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890,"decimal":1.000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001}`)
	absent.EssExtra["requiredValue"] = EssJSON{Raw: json.RawMessage(`false`)}
	if _, err := json.Marshal(absent); err == nil { t.Fatal("extra key collision accepted") }
}

func TestNativeShapesAndNegativeControls(t *testing.T) {
	var nilVariant *ChoiceV0
	if _, err := json.Marshal(Choice{Value: nilVariant}); err == nil { t.Fatal("typed nil variant widened a non-nullable union") }
	roundTrip[Choice](t, `{"requiredNullable":null,"requiredValue":null,"large":12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890}`)
	roundTrip[Choice](t, `{"type":true}`)
	roundTrip[Tuple](t, `["ready",{"large":12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890},"tail"]`)
	roundTrip[Node](t, `{"children":[{"children":[]},{}]}`)
	roundTrip[Dictionary](t, `{"huge":12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890}`)
	for _, text := range []string{`["ready",true]`, `["ready",true,"tail",false]`, `null`} {
		var value Tuple
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &value) == nil { t.Fatal("invalid tuple accepted", text) }
	}
	var closed Closed
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"type":true,"extra":1}`), &closed) == nil { t.Fatal("closed object widened") }
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"type":null}`), &closed) == nil { t.Fatal("null became false") }
	var narrow Narrow
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"paused"`), &narrow) == nil { t.Fatal("reference siblings discarded") }
	roundTrip[Narrow](t, `"ready"`)
	var impossible Impossible
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`null`), &impossible) == nil { t.Fatal("false schema accepted") }
	if _, err := json.Marshal(impossible); err == nil { t.Fatal("false schema zero value serialized") }
	var number EssNumber
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"1"`), &number) == nil { t.Fatal("numeric string coerced") }
	if _, err := json.Marshal(number); err == nil { t.Fatal("invalid number zero value serialized") }
	var list List
	data, err := json.Marshal(list)
	if err != nil || string(data) != "[]" { t.Fatal("nil slice did not remain an array", string(data), err) }
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`null`), &list) == nil { t.Fatal("non-nullable list accepted null") }
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[null]`), &list) == nil { t.Fatal("non-nullable element accepted null") }
}
